preconditions.description: The number of houses N is an integer greater than 1 and at most 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a < b <= N for a, b in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct houses a and b, where 1 ≤ a, b ≤ N.
There are exactly N-1 roads, ensuring the village forms a tree (connected and acyclic).

postconditions.description: The total distance is a non-negative integer representing the sum of shortest path distances for all villagers.
Each villager is assigned a valid house number between 1 and N.
postconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= N for v_i in assignment)

postconditions.description: No villager is assigned to their original house (derangement).
postconditions.expression: all(v_i != i for i, v_i in enumerate(assignment, start=1))

postconditions.description: The assignment is a permutation of houses (each house is assigned to exactly one villager and vice versa).
The total distance is the sum of shortest path distances from each house i to its assigned house v_i.
postconditions.expression: total_distance == sum(shortest_path(i, v_i) for i, v_i in enumerate(assignment, start=1))

postconditions.description: The total_distance is the minimum possible sum of shortest path distances for any valid derangement assignment of villagers to houses.
postconditions.expression: not exists(assignment_prime) (all(1 <= v_i <= N for v_i in assignment_prime) and all(v_i != i for i, v_i in enumerate(assignment_prime, start=1)) and len(set(assignment_prime)) == N and sum(shortest_path(i, v_i) for i, v_i in enumerate(assignment_prime, start=1)) < total_distance)
